extra.final_summary: The data had three issues affecting the analysis: (1) one row with a negative flipper length (-181 mm) was excluded as it is biologically implausible; (2) three rows had body mass values outside the plausible range (2,500–6,500 g), including one with 3,700,000 g, which was clearly a data entry error; (3) one row had a misspelled sex label ('FEMALE' instead of 'female'), which was normalized. After these fixes, the total body mass for each species was calculated on 60 valid rows. The final results are: Adelie: 108,975 g, Chinstrap: 37,725 g, Gentoo: 98,350 g.
